pages.title: Link a button and lock
pages.text: $(li)Place a Wireless Button.$(li)Hold a Wireless Lock item and right-click the button to copy its channel.$(li)Place the lock near your Door Markers or storage cubes.$(li)Operate the button with an empty hand.$(br2)The button toggles its channel. The Wireless Lock unlocks nearby doors and storage cubes while the channel is on. Its hologram arrows adjust the horizontal and vertical control ranges. Keep the button and lock loaded to process new signals. A returning door or storage cube receives the controller’s current state even if the signal has not changed.

pages.title: Copy or change a channel
pages.text: Right-click a channel device with a wireless item to $(thing)read$() its channel into that item.$(br2)Sneak-right-click a placed device with a linked item to $(thing)write$() the item’s channel into the device.$(br2)A Signal Transmitter sends a redstone input; a Signal Receiver outputs the channel value. Devices need loaded chunks. Use one signal source per channel.
